We connect candidates with the most attractive employers in Romania. Below you can find a selection of jobs from top companies in Romania.
What we are looking for A Senior Security Engineer with 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, including security engineering, penetration testing, and/or software development. Someone to work transversally, with various interlocutors, internally and within the Group, for a wide variety of projects (IT, Cloud, Data IA, Business Intelligence, IoT,..) What you need to know/have Knowledge of IT technologies Knowledge of computer security good practices : ISO2700x, NIST, CIS, etc. Experience with security risk assessment, g. ISO27005 or EBIOS Risk Manager methodology Familiarity with Cyber Threat Intelligence & Vulnerability Management Awareness with European and international regulations, such as NIS 2, CRA, and GDPR Methodological & Rigorous Result oriented & KPI oriented Work in an international and multicultural environment Able to work in a transversal way Fluent in English; French will be a plus Autonomous with good capability for team work Solid interpersonal skills Technical curiosity Synthesis skills   What youll be doing Work closely with project managers to help them assess and record security risks and to assess follow compliance with the Security by Design program requirements   Organize and facilitate Risk Assessment Advisory reviews, to advise projects and measure their sensitivity to cyber risk,   Consolidate the risks and maintain a risk map to report to the Board of Directors Follow the treatment plans for critical risks Carry out security risk assessments for strategic projects, using an ISO27005-compliant methodology (ex: EBIOS Risk Manager) Contribute to the implementation of security policies Whats in it for you Performance Bonuses - based on your results & the companys Electronic Meal Tickets Medical & Life insurance for you - facilities for your family, too Professional GSM subscription Personal GSM subscription, also [because we believe in communication!] Special grants on Smartphones & devices; discounts for Orange products & services Development Platforms - Orange Learning, Trainings, Career Counselling, Coaching & Career plan mentoring Wellbeing Programs - we support your Zen
